title: The Broken Choir Again
author: Emrys Iversen
blurb: Ada Montrose, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
